source(output(
		setid as string,
		jobcode as string,
		effdt as string,
		eff_status as string,
		descr as string,
		descrshort as string,
		job_function as string,
		setid_salary as string,
		sal_admin_plan as string,
		grade as string,
		step as short,
		manager_level as string,
		survey_salary as integer,
		survey_job_code as string,
		union_cd as string,
		std_hours as integer,
		std_hrs_frequency as string,
		comp_frequency as string,
		job_family as string,
		reg_temp as string,
		company as string,
		barg_unit as string,
		labor_agreement as string,
		med_percent as short,
		mos_percent as short,
		upp_percent as short,
		ph_setid_classnbr as string,
		classif_nbr as string,
		ph_tl_paramed_cl as short,
		ppv_job_descr as string,
		ppv_crim_check as string,
		ph_stat_detail as string,
		descrlong as string,
		ppv_dept_statement as string,
		ppv_qualification as string,
		ppv_cls_statement as string,
		comments as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Declare @full_load varchar(1)  select  @full_load = full_partial_load from ps_hcm.cfg_table_load_parameter  SELECT         [setid]       ,[jobcode]       ,[effdt]       ,[eff_status]       ,[descr]       ,[descrshort]       ,[job_function]        ,[setid_salary]       ,[sal_admin_plan]       ,[grade]       ,[step]       ,[manager_level]       ,[survey_salary]       ,[survey_job_code]       ,[union_cd]       ,[std_hours]       ,[std_hrs_frequency]       ,[comp_frequency]       ,[job_family]       ,[reg_temp]       ,[company]       ,[barg_unit]       ,[labor_agreement]       ,[med_percent]       ,[mos_percent]       ,[upp_percent]       ,[ph_setid_classnbr]       ,CASE WHEN LEFT(classif_nbr, 1) = \'0\' THEN RIGHT(classif_nbr, len(classif_nbr) - 1) ELSE classif_nbr END AS classif_nbr       ,[ph_tl_paramed_cl]       ,[ppv_job_descr]       ,[ppv_crim_check]       ,[ph_stat_detail]       ,[descrlong]       ,[ppv_dept_statement]       ,[ppv_qualification]       ,[ppv_cls_statement]       ,[comments]   FROM [ps_hcm].[ps_jobcode_tbl] where @full_load = \'F\' or datepart(dw,getdate()) = 1 or effdt >=dateadd(dd,-90, getdate())',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		classification_code as string,
		classification_name as string,
		designated_group as string,
		family as string,
		sub_family as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Cast(CLASSIFICATION_CODE AS VARCHAR) AS classification_code,        Classification_Name                  AS classification_name,        Designated_Group                     AS designated_group,        CASE          WHEN ( Family IS NULL                  OR Family = \'\' ) THEN \'N/A\'          ELSE Family        END                                 AS family,        SubFamily                           AS sub_family FROM   ps_hcm.lkp_hscis_classif_code',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> hsciscodesLKPTABLE	source(output(
		job_family as string,
		job_family_descr as string,
		job_family_descr_short as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select job_family, descr as job_family_descr, descrshort as job_family_descr_short from ( select job_family, descr, descrshort, r = DENSE_RANK() over (partition by job_family order by effdt desc) from ps_hcm.ps_job_family_tbl) jf where r=1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> jobfamilyLKPTABLE	source(output(
		job_code_key as integer,
		setid as string,
		jobcode as string,
		effdt as date,
		eff_status as string,

		job_function as string,
		job_function_description as string,
		setid_salary as string,
		sal_admin_plan as string,
		grade as string,
		step as short,
		manager_level as string,
		manager_level_description as string,
		survey_salary as integer,

		ph_hscis_family as string,
		ph_hscis_subfamily as string,
		job_family_descr as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from hr.dim_job_code',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE	source(output(
		job_function as string,
		descr as string,
		descrshort as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select job_function,descr,descrshort from  (SELECT     job_function, effdt, descr, eff_status, descrshort, DENSE_RANK() over (partition by job_function order by effdt desc) as rk FROM         ps_hcm.ps_jobfunction_tbl) ranked where rk=1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupJobFnLKPTABLE	source(output(
		fieldvalue as string,
		xlatlongname as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select fieldvalue , xlatlongname from (select fieldvalue , xlatlongname , DENSE_RANK() over (partition by fieldname order by effdt desc) as rk from  ps_hcm.xlattable where fieldname = \'MANAGER_LEVEL\') ranked where rk=1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupManagerLvlLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupJobFnLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@job_function == LookupJobFnLKPTABLE@job_function,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupJobFn
